infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: EcoQuest uses your camera to capture real-time photographic proof of your eco-activities. Photos are cryptographically timestamped and uploaded to decentralized storage to verify quest completion on the Solana blockchain.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: EcoQuest uses your precise GPS location to verify that you are physically present at the quest site. Location data is hashed and stored on-chain — your exact coordinates are never shared with third parties.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: EcoQuest requires location access to validate eco-activity quests in real time. Your location is only used during active quest sessions.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: EcoQuest uses your precise GPS location to verify that you are physically present at an eco-activity quest site. Your exact coordinates are cryptographically hashed — they are never stored in plaintext or shared with third parties.
plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: EcoQuest requires location access during active quest sessions to validate eco-activities on the Solana blockchain.

plugins.cameraPermission: EcoQuest uses your camera exclusively to capture real-time photographic proof of eco-activities. The app cannot access your photo library — only live camera captures are permitted. Photos are cryptographically signed and uploaded to decentralized storage (IPFS/Arweave).

plugins.photosPermission: EcoQuest menggunakan galeri foto untuk mengatur foto profil Anda.
plugins.cameraPermission: EcoQuest menggunakan kamera untuk mengambil foto profil Anda.
